        <description>Script include that creates stock and core cases when the expected transition time has elapsed and a case has not been created previously</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>MSSCustodyCaseCreation</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var MSSCustodyCaseCreation = Class.create();
MSSCustodyCaseCreation.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    mssCustodyCoreCaseCreation: function() {

        //Blanket the case creation logic with case suppression check, check is Case Suppression is ON (true) or OFF (false). Case is created only when the property value is set to false 
        if (gs.getProperty("x_hsb11_mss_custod.isCustodyCaseSuppressionON") == "false") {

            var bpInstance = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_custod_mss_custody_business_process_instance");
            var sysTime = new GlideDateTime();
            var createCaseAfterSuppTimestamp = new GlideDateTime(gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_custod.createCaseAfterSuppressionTimestamp')); //fetches the date time from timestamp to be considered for creating cases

            bpInstance.addQuery("is_case_created_core", false);
            bpInstance.addQuery("is_core_status_exception", false);
            bpInstance.addQuery("core_expected_transition_time", "<", sysTime);
            bpInstance.addQuery("core_expected_transition_time", ">", createCaseAfterSuppTimestamp);
            bpInstance.addQuery("core_expected_transition_time", "!=", "");
            bpInstance.addQuery("is_core_terminal_status", 'false');

            bpInstance.query();
            while (bpInstance.next()) {

                try {

                    //MSSCUSTODY-5439 get real time information from BPI to check if case creation is still required on this BPI
                    var bpiInLoop = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_custod_mss_custody_business_process_instance");
                    bpiInLoop.get(bpInstance.sys_id);

                    var nowTime = new GlideDateTime();
                    var bpiUPdateTime = new GlideDateTime(bpiInLoop.sys_updated_on);
                    var diffSeconds = (nowTime.getNumericValue() - bpiUPdateTime.getNumericValue()) / 1000;
                    var timeElapsed = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_custod.timeElapsed');

                    //MSSCUSTODY-5439 update the conditons to get the real-time BPI record to check
                    //if ((bpInstance.is_case_created_core == false) && (bpInstance.is_core_status_exception == false) && (bpInstance.core_expected_transition_time < sysTime) && (bpInstance.core_expected_transition_time != sysTime) && (diffSeconds > timeElapsed)) {
                    if ((bpiInLoop.is_case_created_core == false) && (bpiInLoop.is_core_status_exception == false) && (bpiInLoop.is_core_terminal_status == false) && (bpiInLoop.core_expected_transition_time != '') && (bpiInLoop.core_expected_transition_time != null) && (bpiInLoop.core_expected_transition_time != undefined) && (bpiInLoop.core_expected_transition_time < nowTime) && (diffSeconds > timeElapsed)) { //MSSCUSTODY-8134 - Conditin Updated

                        //MSSCUSTODY-5439 update the flag to true to lock the BPI only when case creation starts
                        bpInstance.core_case_creation_in_progress = true;
                        bpInstance.update();

                        var custodyCase = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_case");
                        custodyCase.initialize();
                        custodyCase.short_description = "Investigate " + bpInstance.core_stage_reference.status;
                        custodyCase.triggered_by = bpInstance.core_stage_reference; //Populating Triggered by field in Custody case record - MSSCUDTODY-705
                        custodyCase.description = "This case is created when a Trade remains in " + bpInstance.core_stage_reference.status + " for longer than expected. This case will remain open until a new trade lifecycle status is received";
                        custodyCase.u_fo_process_status = bpInstance.core_stage_reference;
                        custodyCase.u_object_type = bpInstance.object_type;
                        custodyCase.trade_id = bpInstance.trade_id;
                        //var bpiValue = bpInstance.number;  MSSCUSTODY-5439 commented out this line as this variable is not in used
                        //custodyCase.u_business_process_instance = current.sys_id;
                        //MSSCUSTODY-5439 get sys_id from gliderecord instead of current
                        custodyCase.u_business_process_instance = bpInstance.sys_id;
                        custodyCase.u_source = bpInstance.source_system;
                        var newobjectid = custodyCase.insert(); // this should be mapped somewhere

                        //3733/3732 before the case type change to auto
                        //new x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyBulkUtils().updateAutomatedManulTask(current.trade_id, newobjectid);
                        //MSSCUSTODY-5439 get trade_id from gliderecord instead of current
                        new x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyBulkUtils().updateAutomatedManulTask(bpInstance.trade_id, newobjectid);

                        bpInstance.is_case_created_core = true;
                        bpInstance.case_counter++;
                        bpInstance.core_case_creation_in_progress = false;
                        bpInstance.update();
                        new x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyBulkUtils().setTradeCaseType(bpInstance.trade_id, 'automated');
                    }

                } catch (err) {
                    gs.error('Script Include - MSSCustodyCaseCreation - error when creating case for BPI ' + bpInstance.number + ': ' + err.message);
                }

            }
        }
    },
